name: vg-brain-mac
description: VG Brain (macOS, zero-install): connects with no system Node via a bundled, self-contained mcp-remote binary and a /bin/sh arch-selecting shim (Apple Silicon + Intel). Same OAuth, RBAC, audit log, full-text search, draft-by-default writes, and automatic session capture as the cross-platform plugin. Authenticates via OAuth (no baked secret).
